SepulcherNpc/31452.htm.text: Ghost of Wigoth: You've destroyed the Shadow of Halisha! Good job!

Q00620_FourGoblets/31452-01.html.text: Ghost of Wigoth: They were Alectia, Tishas, Mekara, Morigul. Their devilish features bely their royal beauty. Let's get out of here.
when: state STARTED; has items 7256,7257,7258,7259; lacks items 7262

Q00620_FourGoblets/31452-02.html.text: Ghost of Wigoth: Come on, let's get out of here!

Q00620_FourGoblets/31452-03.html.text: Ghost of Wigoth: I already gathered three goblets. You did good too. I'm not brave enough to face those women.

Q00620_FourGoblets/31452-05.html.text: Ghost of Wigoth: They were once my companions. Let's get out of here, quickly!

Q00620_FourGoblets/31452-04.html.text: Ghost of Wigoth: I'll tell you later. Let's get out of here first.
